extension.description: Pawn tools for VS Code. Includes syntax highlighting, snippets and completions for common libraries.
configuration.title: Pawn Tools
setting.includePaths.description: Additional Pawn include directories. Relative paths are resolved from each workspace folder.
setting.compilerPath.description: Path to the Pawn compiler executable or its directory. Used to locate the adjacent pawn.cfg and standard include directory.
setting.performanceLogging.description: Collect local performance statistics for workspace indexing, Pawn analysis, semantic tokens and IntelliSense requests.
setting.functionSearchScope.description: Controls which files are searched for cross-file functions, native declarations and symbols in Completion, Hover, Go to Definition and Signature Help.
setting.functionSearchScope.includes: Fastest: search the current file and files it includes recursively. Standard functions such as SetPlayerPos are found through a_samp.inc when it is included.
setting.functionSearchScope.compilationU: Search the current file, its includes, and files that include it.
setting.functionSearchScope.workspace: Search every indexed Pawn file in the workspace and configured include directories. This can be slower in large projects.
